在6月4日的会议上，Srisati女士将澄清围绕新电话系统的所有误解。
A. look out
B. check in
C. clear up
D. take off

items.question: At the meeting on June 4, Ms. Srisati will ------- all misunderstandings surrounding t new phone system.
